meta.title: TIM — your entire business in one system
meta.description: A business management system for shops, restaurants and companies: inventory, till, accounting and staff in one place. Clear, with no training needed.

hero.title: Your entire business — in one system
hero.lead: Inventory, till, accounting and staff — in one system. Clear from day one, with no training and no lengthy setup.

features.title: Everything your business needs, in one place
features.lead: Inventory, till, accounting and staff all run in one system. The numbers add up automatically.

warehouse.title: Inventory
warehouse.text: Stock in, stock out and balances per location. Stocktaking without pausing work.

checkout.title: Till
checkout.text: Sales, refunds and shifts. The receipt prints and stock is deducted straight away.

accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.text: Income, expenses and cash flow. Reports build themselves — no manual spreadsheets.

staff.title: Staff
staff.text: Role-based access, shifts and each person's sales. You can see who did what.

industries.title: Ready-made solutions for your business
industries.lead: Pick your industry — TIM configures itself automatically.

howItWorks.title: Up and running in three simple steps

signup.title: Sign up
signup.text: Create an account in a minute — just an email and your business name. No card.

modules.title: Pick your modules
modules.text: Tick what you need: till, inventory, finance. TIM assembles the system around your business.

start.title: Start working
start.text: Add your products and start selling. Reports and stock levels are calculated automatically.

pricing.title: Honest plans with no surprises
pricing.lead: Pay only for what you need. Change your plan at any time.

basic.name: Basic
basic.tagline: For a single location, to get started

ctaStrip.title: Ready to bring order to your business?
ctaStrip.lead: Try TIM for free. No card, no training, no complicated setup.

footer.description: Trade · Management · Finance. A simple business management system for shops, restaurants and companies.
